_comment: One source for the /design-system page and the MCP server (scripts/system/mcp.mjs): the three sizes, the tools agents call, and the gates work passes on the way out. Edit here and both change.

sizes.label: Sketch
checks: Colours come from the tokens (check_source flags anything raw)

sizes.label: Playground
checks: Every class block has a stylesheet (no one-off blocks)
Reuse first: get_component names the nearest existing component

sizes.label: Production
sizes.loose: Nothing without a reason written down
checks: Every class block has a stylesheet
Reuse first, and the component is in the registry with where it's documented
Copy reads in the right register (get_voice) and passes check_copy
Images have alt, links that open a tab have rel, no positive tabIndex
States drawn: empty, long, loading, error
The steel curtain holds on the pull request

tools.name: search_system
tools.summary: Search components, tokens and the written rules at once.
tools.description: Search the portfolio's design system: components (from the generated catalog), colour tokens (DESIGN.md names joined to the Sass tokens) and sections of DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md. Use it before building anything, to find what already exists.

tools.name: get_component
tools.summary: One component: blocks, stylesheets, raw colours, relatives, registry entry.
tools.description: Get one component by name: its file, the class blocks it draws with, the stylesheets that define them, any raw colours with the token each should be, the existing components it most resembles, and its registry entry (size, where it's documented, or 'proposed'). Reuse or extend before adding a new one.

tools.name: find_tokens
tools.summary: The colour tokens, or the token a raw hex should have been.
tools.description: List the colour tokens with their DESIGN.md role names, or pass a hex value to get the nearest token and whether it is an exact match, a close one, or nothing close.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.summary: A section of DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md by name.
tools.description: Read the written rules. With no topic, lists every section of DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md; with a topic ("Colors", "Motion", "Do's and Don'ts", "The Process, Stated Once"), returns that section.

tools.name: get_voice
tools.summary: How copy reads: the thesis, registers, moves and the never list.
tools.description: How copy on this site should read, from the ryan-taste skill: the one-line thesis, the voice constants (I am / I am not), the seven registers and the rule each one follows, the moves that make it sound like Ryan, the invariants, and the never list. Pass a register ("Note", "Product copy", "Case study", ...) to get that register's rule first.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.summary: What gets checked at sketch, playground or production size.
tools.description: The checklist for one of the system's three sizes: sketch (anyone, loosely governed), playground (the team, real components) or production (everything). Use it to decide how much to check before handing work on.

tools.name: check_source
tools.summary: The curtain's system and accessibility rules, run on code before it's written.
tools.description: Check a TSX or SCSS snippet with the same deterministic rules the steel curtain runs on a pull request: raw colours get the token they should be (SYS001, SYS003 inline), class blocks with no stylesheet (SYS002), and the accessibility basics (A11Y001 image without alt, A11Y002 new tab without rel, A11Y003 positive tabIndex, A11Y004 click handler on a div). Run it on new styles, className or JSX before finishing. Findings say whether the curtain would block.

tools.name: check_copy
tools.summary: Copy against the never list and label headings in ryan-taste.
tools.description: Check copy (TSX, markdown or plain text) against Ryan's voice rules, parsed from the ryan-taste skill: phrases on the never list (COPY001) and headings that are labels instead of claims (COPY002). Deterministic and advisory. For how copy should read, call get_voice.

tools.name: review_change
tools.summary: The full steel curtain on your branch, before the pull request. Local only.
tools.description: Only inside a checkout of the repo: run the steel curtain on the working tree against a base ref (default origin/main), exactly as the pull request will. Returns blocking findings, findings to address (system, accessibility, copy), registry proposals for new components and style blocks, and what the system should absorb.

gates.check: check_source, check_copy and review_change over MCP
Steel curtain: raw colours with a token, unstyled blocks, images without alt, positive tabIndex
Steel curtain: copy against ryan-taste, other accessibility and drift findings, registry proposals
Build, prerender, hydration on every route, Dive Club isolation
The same build gates again, then live bundles load
Full accessibility audit (axe) and visual regression
